facts.value: International trade studies the determinants of the flows of goods and services across international boundaries. It also concerns the size and distribution of gains from trade.
Estimating the effects of changing tariff rates and trade quotas.
International finance is a macroeconomic field that examines the flow of capital across international borders and the effects of these movements on exchange rates.
Increased trade in goods, services, and capital between countries is a major effect of contemporary globalisation.
